description: This file defines the class TransactionProccessingResult, which encapsulates the result of processing a transaction, including whether there was an overpayment and the amount of the overpayment.

classes.name: TransactionProccessingResult
classes.description: A class representing the outcome of a loan transaction processing, including overpayment details.

methods.name: TransactionProccessingResult
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the transaction processing result with overpayment amount and flag.

methods.name: getOverPaymentAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of overpayment as a Money object.

methods.name: isOverPayment
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction resulted in an overpayment.
